pose: A vibrant terracotta-colored buoy equipped with outrigger-style solar panel arrays shaped like canoe paddles that float directly on the water. Brightly colored coastal crabs are clambering over the warm, low-slung metal rungs.

environmental_details.ground: Shallow, calm tropical lagoon water displaying a beautiful gradient from bright golden ochre sand to vivid turquoise.
environmental_details.atmosphere: High-key tropical sun with subtle heat shimmer effects rising from the exposed metallic solar paddles.
